text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Puha! Fuwaa, so good～……♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to have you treat me. 
Um～……Fusaichi Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, just Pandora is totally fine! 
But I'm the one that should be
apologizing!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay after I stepped on you? 
I stepped pretty hard didn't I!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine!
I was sleeping in a weird place too after
all～. 
After a little sun bathing,
I just dozed off.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right……Pandora-san,
weren't you talking out loud? 
It sounded like it was pretty
serious……right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh……you heard that? 
Nnnnnn～～～……well, you see——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
——That's what they said!
You wouldn't want to watch 
yourself getting crushed that badly right!?
And with everyone on your team!
Isn't that just like putting on a show!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way no way no way, too embarrassing!! 
I～～～ just can't do it～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
O-oh,
I see……but Pandora-san ran as best as she
could, 
so I don't think there's anything to be
embarrassed about……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's not it!! Because…………because～!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could do it! 
Just like you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehh——me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kraft-chan's 『Hanshin Uma Musume S』,
I saw it. I was competing 
in the 『Oka Sho』 the next day so I showed
up a day early——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……so to be honest,
I only saw it by coincidence. But,
I thought 
it was amazing! Amazing, unreal,
I want to do that too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……! You were watching me then——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That I want to do that too,
and that I would…… 
But then, but then～! Ahhh～～～ geez～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……since I'm a genius,
I thought I could do it. 
That from now on I'd do things that would
shock everyone——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That I'd make history, maybe? 
That I'd be an awesome Uma Musume,
just like that……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oooh～……an amazing, awesome,
history-maker……huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……Fufufuu. 
I kind of get that.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I understand that feeling, Pandora-san. 
Me too,
I think it would be nice to become someone
like that.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kraft-san too?
……you mean that talk about becoming 
amazing, awesome,
and history-making Uma Musume?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……is that right?
While your race really was amazing,
when talking 
to you……you don't really give off that kind
of vibe though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Even like this,
I have a really big ambition～.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even I think about that. 
——『I want to leave my mark』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Always chasing after the senpais that I
admired, 
their running,
it's almost as if it lives on through me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Me too,
I want someone to follow after me in that
same way. 
I want my running to be what connects me to
someone else——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And like that,
allll the way in to the future, 
and hopefully the reason for my existence
will remain.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……I really want it to remain. 
That's what I think.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ——Eh, so complicated! What do you mean!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh!? W-was that too difficult!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, too hard!! Crazy!! 
…………Ah, but.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So like alllll the way in to the future 『I'm
super amazing!』 
would remain? ……Something like that?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: You know, that sounds……really nice.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……Yeah……——Yeah! 
I think I'm getting fired up!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……! Yeah, right, that's right! 
That someone far in to the future might
still talk about me……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It'd be like you became a legend, right!? 
Eh, no way～! Ahaa,
that sounds great! Seriously!!

text_block_list.name: Pandora & Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aahahaha……! 
Ehehehe～……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu……Hey,
Pandora-san. Just for a little 
longer,
can I have a bit more of your time?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Nnnph. Next,
thread the stem through here～……there! 
Alright, it's done～!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh～……!? No way! Hand-made!? 
No way! Amazing～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm really happy……but. Eh, for me? ……Why?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hm～, Let's see～……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well, earlier. 
You said that you saw my run, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You saw it, and then……you thought 『Me too』,
right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Yeah, I did say that. 
But, it really was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Hmmmm? ……That's it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Aha——Yeah! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even just that made me happy. 
……So I just wanted to give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: For you, a Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ——Kraft-chan……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Wah. ……Amazing)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Her eyes. ……Are so sparkly——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(……That's right. That's right,
that's right!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I may have come up with something super
genius-like……♡)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hya～, it's already nighttime……! 
I'm sorry we got back so late,
Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's because you tagged along with me
while 
I was taking photos,
wasn't it? I'm sorry……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, why are you apologizing?
There's still plenty of 
time until curfew☆ The two-shot came out
really well 
so I'm pumped♪ You're good at taking photos,
huh～!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And so,
you're sending those photos to a buddy
working 
hard far away? Umm,
with some kind of Exchange Diary app?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, her name's Cesario.
I was talking with her earlier. 
Fufufuu,
I'll write a bunch about Pandora-san in the
diary too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yaaa～n,
make sure you praise me looooots～～～☆ 
Super genius, super lovely, and——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Nihi. After that, it's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ? ……Pandora-san?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nothing♡ Then, I'll get going!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: See ya again～～～ Ku-chan-senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, wah, okay! See ya——

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……Hm? 
……『Ku-chan-senpai』?
